english_outline.section1_main_conclusion: Meta's Q2 2026 revenue beat but profit missed; stock fell on legal charges, severance, and AI-driven free cash flow collapse.
english_outline.section2_core_business_changes: Ad business healthy: impressions +14%, price +12%, DAU 3.60B. Costs surged from $2.40B legal and $1.18B severance. Capex $31.08B crushed FCF to $784M, down 91% YoY.
english_outline.section3_expectations: Revenue outlook $61-64B for Q3. Capex guidance raised to $130-145B. Margin pressure from AI infrastructure and legal costs. FCF squeeze persists.
english_outline.section4_market_pricing: Stock fell 9% premarket. Analysts split: eToro's Gilbert says Meta spends like hyperscaler without business model; Bernstein's Shmulik calls call a brainstorming session. JPMorgan and Wells Fargo analysts pressed for compute monetization details.
english_outline.section5_next_quarter_validation: Q3 revenue delivery within $61-64B. Clarity on compute monetization path. Legal cost trajectory. Capex efficiency and FCF recovery.

reader_questions: 稿件称“自由现金流骤降至仅7.84亿美元，同比暴跌91%”，但官方来源的已验证事实中并未列出自由现金流数据，该数字是否可靠、是否应保留？
稿件称“资本支出指引下限被上调50亿美元，区间升至1300亿至1450亿美元”，但官方来源的已验证事实只给出当季资本支出310.8亿美元和Q3营收指引610亿至640亿美元，资本支出指引区间是否有来源支持？
稿件称“股价盘前下跌9%”，但官方来源未提及股价，市场报道中该跌幅是否应作为市场定价证据保留，还是应改用更稳妥的表述？
checks: 核查：官方来源已验证事实未包含自由现金流数字；路透社分析文章确实提到“free cash flow of just $784 million”和“collapse, of 91% from a year ago”，并称股价盘前下跌9%。因此该数字有市场报道支持，但不应表述为官方财报事实，修订稿应明确归因于路透社报道。
核查：官方来源已验证事实未列出资本支出指引区间；路透社分析文章提到“raised the low end of its capital spending forecast by $5 billion, lifting the range to between $130 billion and $145 billion”。该数据有市场报道支持，但原稿未标注来源，修订稿应保留并归因于路透社。
核查：官方来源未提及股价；路透社分析文章提到“drove its stock down 9% premarket on Thursday”。该股价反应有市场报道支持，但属于市场报道而非公司官方披露，修订稿应保留并明确来源。
